It is not a universal hydrostatic stress-controlled unloading slope, nor a finite unloading trajectory at arbitrary density. findings.consistent_mapping_example: One consistent option is sigma_source=-sigma_compression, D_source=-D_compression, delta_source=-delta_compression. Thenh_source=-h_compression andq is invariant, so the AppendixB branch condition andmemory form are preserved. L andfs/fd are unchanged, while N_compression=-N_source. The source tensorA becomes fsL-(sigma_compression/lambda_star) outer I; source normalizedstress ratios andd remain computed consistently from invariant normalizedstress. Applying only stress/strain flips but leavingmemory unexamined can interchange loading branches.
findings.verified_compression_positive_rate: With Sigma=-sigma_source, E=-D_source and H=-delta_source, q=h_A:E is invariant. Define Q=fs*L:d-Sigma*tr(d)/lambda_star. Positive branch Sigma_dot=c*fs*L:E+rho^chi*(1-mT)*fs*(L:h_A)*q+rho^chi*(fd/fdA)*Q*q; nonpositive branch replaces corrections withrho^chi*(mR-mT)*fs*(L:h_A)*q. H_dot=E-h_A*rho^beta_r*q forpositiveq, otherwiseE. Here d is the source normalized-invariant direction, not silently negated; N_A=Q/(fs*fdA). These signs agree with the parent proposed mapping and reduce to the previously checked compression-positive base law at aligned saturatedmemory.
